scope: synthetic inputs, real shared weights; OD/ERQA and S1/S2 unmeasured

timing_notes.selection: method/backend/env changes outside measurement; warmup5 per arm block
timing_notes.device_ms: event interval includes stream gaps; not kernel-only time
timing_notes.host_submit_ms: time in Python/framework call; can include internal synchronization
timing_notes.sync_wait_ms: host waiting after end event submission
timing_notes.event_record_host_ms: host time in start/end event record
timing_notes.gap: stream gaps cannot be independently separated from these counters
